title: ApprovalResponse
description: What the decision surface returns. Exactly one of the four responses. Maps to AI SDK addToolApprovalResponse, AG-UI resume entries, CopilotKit respond() and MCP elicitation actions.

reason.description: Optional free text. Never required, for any response.

editedArguments.description: Required when response is edit-and-approve. The full argument values after the human's edits.

alwaysAllow.description: True only when the human ticked the scoped always-allow control alongside approve.
